query: INSERT INTO public.credentials (tenant_id, person_id, password_hash, password_changed_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (person_id) DO UPDATE SET password_hash = EXCLUDED.password_hash, password_changed_at = EXCLUDED.password_changed_at, failed_count = 0, failed_window_start = NULL, locked_until = NULL WHERE credentials.tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id
